take: Utah announced that it recalled forward Ben McCartney from Tucson (AHL), activated Michael Carcone from injured reserve, and placed defenseman John Marino on injured reserve. Marino has been the second pair's 20-minute workhorse, and in the 5 games he's missed, Andrew Peeke has moved in beside Schmidt and is up to 19:38 a night from 14:46, with Mikhail Sergachev up to 25:35 from 21:37. Utah controlled 59.5% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) at five-on-five with Marino on the ice, so that's a real loss. Carcone returns having been outchanced with him on the ice (46.7% at five-on-five).
